bull_case_summary: CelcomDigi has RM445m post-capex/lease cash and RM141m realised savings supporting a conditional integration-repair thesis. Round two accepts payout undercoverage and avoids substituting presentation cash or adding savings twice.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts repair resources but retains RM376m dividend shortfall, falling statutory CFO and rising borrowings. At 19.31x earnings with only 0.9% normalised profit growth, savings and prospective integration targets have not yet demonstrated better cash conversion.
key_points_of_agreement: Positive post-lease cash and realised efficiencies are verified.
Dividends are currently uncovered under the conservative statutory bridge.
Savings cannot be added again and presentation cash uses a different definition.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether integration upside and income appeal sufficiently compensate current cash deterioration and the payout gap.
unresolved_uncertainties: Actual integration conversion and payout adjustment.
Borrowing classification includes lease-related elements; no exclusive net-debt bridge is inferred.
